summary: PGIM Private Credit Fund filed an 8-K to disclose a new $100 million (expandable to $500 million) asset-backed credit facility for its SPV subsidiary. The facility is secured by loan assets, bears floating interest with various benchmark rates, and has a 3-year revolving period plus 2-year maturity. The filing represents standard debt financing, not a special-situation event. It is purely a material definitive agreement with no M&A, restructuring, or corporate-control change, so it is classified as None.
